breaking.change: Every game shader now has `value_noise2(p: vec2<f32>, layer: i32)`, `value_noise3` and `value_noise3_at` in scope from the engine's one copy (value_noise3 was already there in material shaders; sprite, post and UI shaders get it now); a shader that declares one of these names no longer compiles.
breaking.fix: Delete your own copy and call the library's, or rename yours.

added.summary: A game shader may call smooth 2D value noise in [0, 1) over the engine's integer hash, on a lattice layer of its choosing.
